verdict.rationale: Pika documents a reusable character feature: you customize a character, or build a character sheet from a description, traits or reference image, and reuse it across creations. It also offers multi-shot film generation from references and clip continuation that keeps the scene moving, which together address consistency across shots rather than within one clip. missing for 10: detailed docs on how identity and scene consistency are kept across shots, explicit scene/environment persistence beyond continuing from a final frame, independent or hands-on corroboration that characters stay consistent.

support.subject: As a creator, a character or scene stays consistent across multiple generated shots, not just within one clip

citations.quote: Customize a character who can be repeatedly used in your creations.
Start with a description, traits or reference image, then create a character sheet for future projects.
Set the style and add references to develop a script, storyboard and film with multiple shots.
Upload your clip and generate a continuation from its final frame to keep the scene and action moving.
